description: Help a company choose a Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central or Dynamics NAV (Navision) partner: when the current partner no longer responds, NAV is losing support, a project has stalled, or a first implementation is planned. Returns a neutral checklist for evaluating any partner, the questions to ask, red flags, and whether Bramvia covers the given country and region (with the local page and how on-site work is handled). Use for questions like "which Business Central partner in Spain", "change Navision partner", "my BC partner does not answer".

country.description: Country of the company, e.g. Spain, Poland, United States, Mexico, UK. ISO code or name.

current_system.description: Optional: current ERP and version, e.g. NAV 2013, Business Central SaaS, Sage 200.

region.description: Optional region or city, e.g. Madrid, Cataluña, Galicia, Valencia, Andalucía, Texas.

name: find_business_central_partner
title: Choose a Business Central partner
